topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I guess you could say I've been busy. Putting pen to paper, or more like fingers to keys, trying to capture the essence of us. I never meant to keep it a secret, really. It just... unfolded over time. You and I, our story, it's so vivid, so real. I wanted to do it justice. Maybe I got carried away, didn't know how to tell you. Each word, each chapter, is a piece of you, and in turn, a piece of me. I hope, when you read it, you see the care, the love, behind every line.
